repeat_policy.order: Alternate pair order; predeclare alternating starting arm across cases
repeat_policy.cohort: All historical solved-set flips; plus both-solved pairs with max time>=13.6s and multiplicative timing difference>=1.10. Selected from historical data, fixed before new outcomes.
repeat_policy.serious_timing_loss: ALL5pairs both decisively solved within17s; median after/before>=1.10 and>=4/5ratios>1. No survivor-only median.
repeat_policy.censoring: Use solve-rate rule or unresolved; any longer-cap diagnostic requires separately frozen symmetric phase and never replaces17s scores

repeat_policy.rollback: Preserve correctness/exception-safety fixes; independent code review and appropriate tests before publishing any performance-only revert
